{{Quote|You have cleaned the guard? Oiled the action? Filed the symon tube? Checked the lower quartile? Adjusted the mesobanis timer?|Commander Kulkis, to Nightwing, in a story shared on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="The Best Defense">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050310b|text=The Best Defense}}</ref>}}
A '''symon tube''' was a component that could be found in a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and which was required to be filed for the weapon in which it was fitted to function effectively. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the symon tube was mentioned in the short story [[The Best Defense]]<ref name="The Best Defense" /> by the [[Thaereian military]] deserter [[Osten Dal'Nay]],<ref name="Osten Dal'Nay">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20050721ostendalnay|text=Osten Dal'Nay|int=Osten Dal'Nay (article)}}</ref> which depicted the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Thaereian military]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kulkis]] at the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of the enlisted [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Nightwing]]. In the story, Nightwing attempted to remediate a jam in his Thaereian military standard issue [[MX9]] blaster rifle and Kulkis queried whether Nightwing had filed the weapon's symon tube.<ref name="The Best Defense" />
